name: What is the average cost of replacing a door in the Boise area?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost of replacing a door in the Boise area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of door replacement in the Boise area varies significantly based on door material, style, size, and installation complexity. A basic interior door might be a few hundred dollars, while a high-end, custom-sized entry door with specialized glass could cost several thousand. During our consultation, we assess your specific needs and provide a detailed estimate that breaks down material and labor costs, helping you understand the investment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Door replacement costs in Boise vary widely based on material, style, and complexity, from a few hundred to several thousand dollars.
